description: This file defines the 'File' class within the 'ZipStream' namespace, implementing functionality for creating, processing, and managing files within a ZIP archive, including handling file headers, compression, and stream processing.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file within a ZIP archive, managing headers, compression, data processing, and stream handling for ZIP file creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new File instance with the specified ZIP archive, filename, and options.

methods.name: processPath
methods.description: Reads a file from disk at the given path, processing its data and handling large files with streaming.

methods.name: processData
methods.description: Processes raw file data, updates properties like length and CRC, and manages compression if needed.

methods.name: addFileHeader
methods.description: Creates and sends the ZIP file header for this file, including filename encoding and ZIP64 considerations.

methods.name: filterFilename
methods.description: Sanitizes filenames by removing illegal characters for ZIP compatibility.

methods.name: addFileFooter
methods.description: Creates and sends the data descriptor footer for the file, including CRC and size information.

methods.name: processStream
methods.description: Processes a data stream, either with zero headers or computed headers, handling compression and data sending.

methods.name: deflateInit
methods.description: Initializes deflate compression and hash context for data computation.

methods.name: deflateData
methods.description: Updates compression and hash state with new data chunks.

methods.name: deflateFinish
methods.description: Finalizes deflate compression and computes CRC.

methods.name: processStreamWithZeroHeader
methods.description: Handles streaming data with zero header mode, processing and adding headers/footers.

methods.name: readStream
methods.description: Reads data from a stream in chunks, optionally compressing and computing hash.

methods.name: getCdrFile
methods.description: Generates the central directory record (CDR) entry for this file, including all relevant metadata.

methods.name: getTotalLength
methods.description: Returns the total length of the file entry including headers and footers.

methods.name: dosTime
methods.description: Converts a UNIX timestamp to a DOS timestamp used in ZIP headers.

methods.name: buildZip64ExtraBlock
methods.description: Constructs the ZIP64 extended information for files larger than 4GB or with large offsets.
